environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS connecting through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode with prepared statement handling set to 'disallow' (server_reset_query_always=1). PgBouncer sits at port 6432 with a custom query intercept module (pgbouncer-rr with routing rules) that enforces parameterized query patterns only. The pgbouncer-rr routing configuration rejects any query containing PostgreSQL type cast operators (::) adjacent to unparameterized literals in WHERE clauses by matching regex pattern `WHERE\s+\w+\s*=\s*[^$][^:]*::\w+` and returning an error. Additionally, the PgBouncer instance has `disable_pqexec=1` which forces all queries through the extended query protocol, meaning simple query protocol (used by createStatement()) is rejected at the wire protocol level. DATABASE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://pgbouncer-svc.internal:6432/appdb?preferQueryMode=extended

config.pgbouncer_rr: query routing/rejection rules blocking unparameterized type casts in WHERE clauses
config.network: EKS pod -> PgBouncer svc (port 6432) -> RDS (port 5432), no direct RDS access from pods
